quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly's Foundayo (orforglipron) 17.2 mg showed greater (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In a Lilly indirect treatment comparison drawing on ACHIEVE-3 and PIONEER PLUS data (presented at EASD), Foundayo (orforglipron) 17.2 mg was associated with 1.5% greater weight loss (95% CI -2.7%, -0.2%) and 0.3% greater A1C reduction (95% CI -0.6%, -0.1%) than oral semaglutide 25 mg at 52 weeks in adults with type 2 diabetes; analyses using different statistical methods gave 1.5% to 2.4% greater weight loss and 0.3% to 0.6% greater A1C reduction. Rachel Batterham (SVP of medical innovation and external engagement, Lilly Cardiometabolic Health) said head-to-head trials ultimately provide the best comparison, that the results suggest Foundayo may deliver A1C and weight lowering similar to the 25 mg dose of oral semaglutide, and that with administration free of fasting or water restrictions Foundayo is a potentially foundational therapy for adults with type 2 diabetes.
